text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with
Mejiro
Dober...

Urgh... I can't give up looking yet! Hang
in there a
little longer, quads!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure that was Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober! Well, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Ryan and some friends were
invited
to a neighborhood concert as
guest performers,
but someone had to
drop out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The concert's this evening, but I can't
find a
replacement!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! I haven't
even said
anything yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Goodness... You saw right through me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ryan? Can you teach me the songs
and
choreography?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ryan? Can you teach me the songs
and
choreography?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What?! Does that mean you're willing to
be our
replacement member?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That'd be great, but... you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It won't be easy, but...

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Star light, star bright, I wish to become a
big,
strong racer who can win any race!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As long as you take it one step at a
time, you'll
move closer to not only me...
but also the racer
you want to become.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I'm going to keep moving forward. And
just like I
promised myself when I was
little...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best not to be a burden!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, you'd never be a burden!
You're the
best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Dober. And thanks to your
trainer too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And now for the final pose!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That was good! I'm glad the outfit is the
right size
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... It looks like we'll be ready for the performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Uh-huh.
choice_data_list: ライブ、楽しみにしてるよ
choice_data_list_en: I'm looking forward to the concert.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Next up is what you've all been waiting
for! Our
special guest performance for
the night!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I almost gave up on my childhood
dream
because I thought I could never
make it happen,
but...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I'm going to reach for it once more...
with
Trainer, this time!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! That was awesome, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Th-thanks...
choice_data_list: おめでとう！すごくよかった！！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, there will be fireworks after
the
performance. They're about to start.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks.
choice_data_list: 改めて、ライブお疲れ様
choice_data_list_en: Once again, great work on the concert.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... I really feel like I
accomplished
something.

堂々としててよかったよ
みんなと打ち上げとかしないの？

Aren't you going to an after-party with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-you're just saying that.

(Still, if my passion really did come

everyone was able to see how
much I've
changed...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If my passion really did come across and
everyone
was able to see how much I've
changed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Then I'm glad I mustered up the
courage to
perform.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober

Then... I'm glad I mustered up the
courage to
perform.

text_block_list.text:
I know this sounds weird, but... these
fireworks
look even more beautiful than
the ones I saw as a
child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I was the one who decided to
perform.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I was the one who decided to
perform.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And I could never embarrass myself in
front of a
crowd or my da—ahem, my
friends.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And I can't embarrass myself in front of
an
audience... or my dad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's not like I need him to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I hope he is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But, maybe if he saw that, he'd realize
he doesn't
have to be so overprotective
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:

worry
about me anymore.

I got invited, but... I hardly know anyone
there.
Besides, I kind of just butted into
this whole
thing...

Besides, I kind of just butted into
this whole
thing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And I had to come tell you I was all
done,
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I just want to watch the
fireworks with
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So... What did you think of the concert?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...So, how do you think I did?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to keep improving and become even more radiant. No, I don't just want to—I'll make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks light up the sky as she makes
her vow,
and I make my own to support
her as best I can to
make that wish come
true.
